Name: RBI Cyber Security Framework for OCI Banking Workloads
Description: Reserve Bank of India baseline cyber security and governance controls for cloud banking, payment systems, and financial entities on OCI.

Requirements.Name: Privileged Access Management & Mandatory MFA
Requirements.Description: Mandate two-factor authentication and quarterly credential rotation for all banking administrators on OCI.

Requirements.Name: Perimeter Defense & Direct Internet Access Restriction
Requirements.Description: Ensure database and analytics clusters are isolated in private subnets with no public internet ingress.

Requirements.Name: Customer-Managed Data Encryption & Key Custody
Requirements.Description: Financial records and card transaction stores must be encrypted using dedicated KMS customer keys with annual rotation.

Requirements.Name: Comprehensive Audit Trail & 365-Day Retention
Requirements.Description: Maintain tamper-evident audit logs of all configuration and transactional events for a minimum of 1 year.
